Patchwork, a GitHub App that opens AI-patched PRs when an API breaks

projects.name: Patchwork
projects.desc: GitHub App that detects breaking changes in API changelogs and opens PRs with AI-generated patches.
projects.long: Closed source for now. Reads third-party API changelogs, finds breaking changes that affect a repo, and opens a pull request with a generated patch for review.

projects.name: MirrorMind
projects.desc: AI digital twin built from Twitter and Reddit history.
projects.long: Builds a conversational twin from a person's Twitter and Reddit history using embeddings and the Claude API.

projects.name: Jarvis
projects.desc: Voice-activated agent loop with vision-based screen control.
projects.long: Runs locally on a LLaMA model. Listens for voice commands and controls the screen using vision.
